role: The single encrypted envelope for every iCloud payload (sessions, live backups, settings): EMQC magic + version byte + AES-GCM combined box sealed with a synchronizable iCloud-Keychain cloud key; decode also opens legacy FR (EncryptionManager archive key) payloads and passes unframed legacy bytes through.
types: CloudPayloadCodec: enum — encode/decode, multi-key Keychain management
state: kc:com.chrissharp.flowrecovery.cloud (synchronizable generic passwords, accounts cloud-payload-key-v1 and cloud-payload-key-id-<UUID>)
kc service constant com.chrissharp.flowrecovery.cloud; legacyAccount cloud-payload-key-v1; accountPrefix cloud-payload-key-id-
toplevel: Static constants only. Keys are created with kSecAttrAccessibleAfterFirstUnlock and kSecAttrSynchronizable=true so they sync via iCloud Keychain.

units.entry: LocalizedError witness; read via localizedDescription in sync error lines

units.does: Returns true when a writing key exists or can be created (calls writingKey, which creates a key on genuine absence); logs and returns false on Keychain read/add failure.
reads: kc:com.chrissharp.flowrecovery.cloud (synchronizable generic passwords, accounts cloud-payload-key-v1 and cloud-payload-key-id-<UUID>)
writes: kc:com.chrissharp.flowrecovery.cloud (synchronizable generic passwords, accounts cloud-payload-key-v1 and cloud-payload-key-id-<UUID>) (new key when none)

branches.effect: log error, return false; else true

units.does: Seals payload with AES-GCM under the writing key and returns magic + version + combined box.
reads: kc:com.chrissharp.flowrecovery.cloud (synchronizable generic passwords, accounts cloud-payload-key-v1 and cloud-payload-key-id-<UUID>)
writes: kc:com.chrissharp.flowrecovery.cloud (synchronizable generic passwords, accounts cloud-payload-key-v1 and cloud-payload-key-id-<UUID>) (new key when none)

branches.effect: throw malformedEnvelope (unreachable with the default 12-byte nonce)

units.does: Decodes a cloud payload: EMQC → openCurrent with the cloud keys; FR → EncryptionManager.decrypt with the device archive key; otherwise returns raw unchanged (pre-encryption compressed record).
reads: kc:com.chrissharp.flowrecovery.cloud (synchronizable generic passwords, accounts cloud-payload-key-v1 and cloud-payload-key-id-<UUID>)

branches.cond: longer than 4 bytes and starts with EMQC
longer than 2 bytes and starts with FR
branches.effect: decrypt with archive key (throws on other devices); else return raw unchanged

units.does: Checks the version byte after the magic and opens the AES-GCM box with every stored cloud key.
reads: kc:com.chrissharp.flowrecovery.cloud (synchronizable generic passwords, accounts cloud-payload-key-v1 and cloud-payload-key-id-<UUID>)

units.does: Tries each key; returns the first successful AES.GCM.open; authenticationFailure moves to the next key; other errors throw; no key opens → noMatchingKey.

branches.effect: continue to next key; other errors propagate

units.does: Returns the stored key under the primary account, or creates a new one when no primary-eligible key exists; Keychain read failures propagate (no key minted over a locked Keychain).
reads: kc:com.chrissharp.flowrecovery.cloud (synchronizable generic passwords, accounts cloud-payload-key-v1 and cloud-payload-key-id-<UUID>)
writes: kc:com.chrissharp.flowrecovery.cloud (synchronizable generic passwords, accounts cloud-payload-key-v1 and cloud-payload-key-id-<UUID>) (create)

branches.cond: primary account found among stored keys

flags.text: No lock around read-then-create: two concurrent first writers (settings push on MainActor, session push, live backup) can each create a key under distinct accounts; harmless by the multi-key design but grows the key set.

units.does: Picks the legacy account when present, else the lexicographically smallest cloud-payload-key-id-* account; nil if none.

branches.effect: return it; else min of prefixed accounts

units.does: Generates a 256-bit key and SecItemAdds it under accountPrefix+UUID (synchronizable, AfterFirstUnlock); throws keyUnreadable(status) on failure.
writes: kc:com.chrissharp.flowrecovery.cloud (synchronizable generic passwords, accounts cloud-payload-key-v1 and cloud-payload-key-id-<UUID>)

units.does: SecItemCopyMatching for all synchronizable cloud keys (data+attributes); returns (account,key) sorted primary-first; [] when none; throws keyUnreadable on any other status.
reads: kc:com.chrissharp.flowrecovery.cloud (synchronizable generic passwords, accounts cloud-payload-key-v1 and cloud-payload-key-id-<UUID>)

units.does: Maps Keychain rows to (account, SymmetricKey), dropping rows missing account or data, sorted so the primary account comes first.
Base Keychain query: generic password, service com.chrissharp.flowrecovery.cloud, synchronizable true.
